gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-serif-he: Chunky beads on a rod, each heavy letter of Impact Label standing alone with little contrast. And it earns its keep big and short, while Noto Serif Hentaigana, a classic serif with a faint stroke shift, handles the rest.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-ovo: Blunt little beads on a rod: Impact Label stamps heavy, near-flat letters, each one standing alone with a high x-height. Ovo, a serif, lends a gentle brush-like contrast below.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-domine: Playful and wobbly, Jelly Crazies draws bold letters with no thicker or thinner strokes, bowls nearly sealed shut. Domine, a text serif, lets each curve breathe, so paragraphs keep moving.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-esteban: Jelly Crazies draws monoline, wobbly letters whose bowls nearly seal shut, giving headings a slow, leisurely walk. Esteban, a serif with moderate contrast, flows onward, its oversized lowercase never feeling squeezed.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-faustina: Wobbly and playful, Jelly Crazies keeps every stroke uniform, its bowls nearly sealed shut. But Faustina, a classic serif, brings the real prize: open-jawed curves that thin gracefully instead of sharply.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-halant: Halant, a classic serif, stands tall with outward-pointing terminals and a faint but real thick-thin shift. And Jelly Crazies, with crossbars as fat as its stems, slows the reading pace to a leisurely walk.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-headland-one: Wire-like, wobbly letters from Jelly Crazies, with bowls nearly sealed shut. Headland One, a text serif, spaces its gently varied letters well apart, so paragraphs settle into an unhurried pace.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hedvig-lette: Playful, wobbly Jelly Crazies draws letters with no thinning and bowls that nearly seal shut. Hedvig Letters Serif, a classic serif, is happiest at ordinary text size, leaving the big sizes to Jelly Crazies.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-lisu-bosa: Stems and arcs move in lockstep, bowls nearly sealed, in Jelly Crazies. Lisu Bosa, a classic serif, spills its counters into open space, giving that wobble a sturdy, tall-lowercase partner.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC, a text serif, reads literary and dignified, its terminals pulled back and its lowercase standing with cast-iron stature. Jelly Crazies, with its wobbly monoline strokes, slows a paragraph to a stroll.
